programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]

That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
